descent.nextHint: Go to the next part of the introduction
descent.companion: Your companion, a yellow rubber duck on a weathered dispenser

beat0.down: Down here, what you keep, remains.

beat1.title: Every memory becomes a relic.
beat1.body: A letter, a photograph, a voice, a place. Each is set in its own lit niche, deeper the further back it goes.

beat2.title: Only you hold the key.
beat2.body: Your vault is private to you, and you can bolt its door with your fingerprint or screen lock.

strength.empty: At least 8 characters. Something only you would know.
strength.short: A few more characters. Eight at least.
strength.fair: It holds, but it could run deeper.

validation.nameRequired: Every Keeper is written in by name.
validation.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
validation.passwordShort: A password needs at least 8 characters.
validation.passwordLong: That password is too long. Keep it under 128 characters.

errors.exists: A Keeper with that email is already in the register. Try signing in instead.
errors.mismatch: That email and password don't match the register. Check them and try again.
errors.unverified: Confirm your email first. A letter is waiting in your inbox.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

signUp.title: Sign the register.
signUp.body: Every Keeper is written in once. Then the vault is yours.

signIn.title: Welcome back, Keeper.
signIn.body: Sign your name and the door will open.

reset.title: Lost your key?
reset.body: Give us the email from the register and we will send a letter to set a new password.
reset.sentTitle: A letter is on its way.
reset.sentBody: If {{email}} is in the register, a link to set a new password will arrive shortly. It can take a minute or two. Check your spam folder as well.
reset.sentArt: A folded letter, tied with red thread
